entries.raw: For each rare pet you bring to me, I'll unlock an additional level in your Taming skill.
entries.text: For each rare pet you bring to me, I'll unlock an additional level in your Taming skill.
entries.zh: 每送来一种我想要的稀有宠物，我就帮你把驯养等级上限提高一级。

entries.raw: To see what pets you need to give me, take a look in my menu!
entries.text: To see what pets you need to give me, take a look in my menu!
entries.zh: 想知道我还缺哪些宠物？打开菜单看看吧！
